## Out-of-scope check

Subarr has explicit non-goals (see [the v1.0 plan](../../README.md)):
- New top-level features that compete with Bazarr / Sonarr / etc.
- Sub generation engines (we use subgen)
- Sub synchronisation (we recommend subsyncarr)
- Multi-host / distributed workers

If your request falls in those areas, propose it as a separate tool
that integrates with subarr instead — that path tends to ship faster
than negotiating scope here.
